coverage.scope: Named resources in age and topic directories, five booklets and their explicit contents, directly attached educational originals. External subject websites are not recursively mirrored. A landing page and its PDF are associated, distinct text and PDF versions can differ.

reuse.policy: Retain existing English edition as an alternate, never use its vectors for Chinese text. Price includes only new Chinese inputs. Additional exact corpus cache hits reduce the estimate.

baseline.rationale: Use complete native reading for text PDFs up to 32 pages, use planKnowledgePdfWindows for longer, scan-heavy or oversized text layers. Count neighbouring pages in window inputs. Separate organizer and independent reviewer. Calibration from previously billed input/output tokens in REQ004_NATIVE_PDF_CHP_20261119.json. Actual tokenization and review outcomes may vary.

media.scenario: For the 61 official scripts: 2–4 passes, 4k–8.5k prompt tokens per video per pass, 0.65–1.6 tokens per script character and 250–1,000 output tokens per call. For remaining videos assume 2–20 minutes for each unknown duration, 1 frame/s, about 100–300 input tokens/s including audio, 2–4 passes, same prompt/output allowances. No user download repeats media processing. Untimed scripts require a separately verified time range or media pass.

excludes: No production writes or paid calls. Provider invoice, cloud storage, egress and future recurring edits are separate. Estimates assume successful acquisition and content rights review. Additional repair rounds require a new allowance.
